inputs.name: hand over from CI/CD Pipeline to Shadow Deployment

output.level_0: The pipeline crashes before shadow deployment, leaving the new model untested and unverified.
output.level_1: No shadow deployment exists, so new models jump straight to production without any safety check.
output.level_2: A developer manually runs the shadow comparison script after the pipeline finishes, often skipping it under pressure.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically triggers a shadow deployment, comparing new and old model outputs before promotion.
output.level_4: Shadow deployment runs with strict governance, logging all comparisons and requiring sign off before production release.
